# AngouriMath

> AngouriMath, an open-source symbolic algebra library for .NET: solve equations and systems, simplify, differentiate, integrate, take limits, and compile expressions.

## Pages

- [Home](https://am.angouri.org/)
- [Quickstart](https://am.angouri.org/quickstart/)
- [What's new](https://am.angouri.org/whatsnew/)
- [Why AngouriMath](https://am.angouri.org/why/)
- [Research](https://am.angouri.org/research/)
- [Demo](https://am.angouri.org/demo/)
- [Wiki](https://am.angouri.org/wiki/)
